comments.author: ByEthanFox
comments.body:
To be honest, I'm not feeling it.

I tried a few character generations and they're not great, and often the turntable sprites are very inconsistent. I feel I'd have to do a lot of work on them.

Trying more generic ideas - like, I say, "I want a knight with long blond hair" gives a reasonable result, but then, if I wanted a generic character there are already a lot of resources for that. My belief is people use creative tools instead of exising character generators because they want to create specific, unique characters.

I can see this being useful in one specific circumstance right now - if I wanted to generate a bunch of placeholder assets that, later, I would have an actual artist fully replace. Like, where I didn't care whether the images look good or not, I just need characters with sort-of the right features, transparent PNGs at specific sprite sizes with a 3-frame run animation. But even now; I usually just take a few characters purchased from asset packs and rotate their colour palette in Photoshop and that tends to do the job.

The automated animation creation system is impressive. Again, I don't feel the results are usable (even the walk cycle feels *off* to me) but, like, credit where it's due, I'm impressed this kind of thing works *at all* and, again, if you had a game with characters with \~20 anims that match this criteria and you wanted placeholders, it might be a pretty good tool to use to generate those, then pay an actual artist to replace later.

(caveat - I don't like using AI for art, but I also don't believe in criticising something I don't understand so I've stayed up to date with my knowledge of AI tools, prompting etc.)

replies.author: Kaninen_Ka9en
replies.body:
Agreed, its not perfect but we are working on improving it! Thanks for reporting on the walk cycle, I will take a look!

1. Guessing you tried rotating sidescroller? It has a harder time doing north-east etc rotations, you can use the rotation tool instead and fix this :) It usually does better with rotating all directions when doing low top-down / high top-down  
2. We recommend not prompting like it is chatgpt and instead just write "knight with long blond hair", you can also use the other tools to fix the images up  
3. We are working on a new background removal which should make it a lot better and consistent

And thanks for trying it out :)

replies.author: ByEthanFox
replies.body: Just for clarity, I didn't write the prompts that way when I tested it; for some reason I just did that when I wrote this Reddit reply.
